description.narrative:
The current review process is meant to provide a pathway for final submission of the revised document in October 2025, prior to theCOP30 in Brazil.
2. Goal and Objectives
2.1. GOAL: The goal of this intervention is the NDC in Mozambique addressing the key challenges of Climate Change with a balanced ambitions that reflect the capacity and responsibility of the country through an all-inclusive process, particularly the most affected communities
2.2. Objectives: 2.2.1. Promoting participation of the affected communities and civil society organisations in consultation process 2.2.2. Strengthen the capacity of Civil society organisation in addressingNDC and implementation plans 2.2.3. Strengthen the capacity of Government Ministry in change of the NDC revision process
3. Proposed Outputs and Activities
Output 1: Affected Communities and Local civil society actors are part of the revision process.
Activities: Activity 1. Support the representatives of communities to participate in future consultation Activity 2. Support Local civil society representatives to participate in future consultations with the government. Activity 3. Run Awareness campaign to educate affected communities on NDC process and climate change related key processes. Activity 4. Produce and develop tailored communication tools and media resources for use in awareness creation among community groups.
Output 2: The knowledge and capacity of Civil society organisations in addressing NDC and implementation plansare strengthened
Activities: Activity 2.1. Strengthen the capacity of the National Civil Society Platform for Climate Change to coordinate Local civil society contribution to the NDC review. Activity 2.2. Support the National Civil Society Platform for Climate Change Forging alliances among allies and movements, and nurturing solidarity with other NSAs – to amplify the voices of key stakeholder groups into the NDC process in each of the selected countries. Activity 2.3: National Civil Society Platform for Climate Change Activity 2.4. Support the National Civil Society Platform for Climate Changeto co-convene stakeholder groups in each country to develop roadmaps for engendering meaningful participation of key groups - women, youth, small-scale farmers and communities. Activity 2.5. Organise a 3 days-National Workshop to establish/agree on key prioritiesin agriculture, WASH, Food systems, Climate Justice for Loss and Damage, and help to set clear plans for just, feminist, and equitable energy transition to be used by the different stakeholders to influence the process. Activity 2.6. Provide training and capacitation of CSOs and key stakeholder groups to increase understanding of their roles and engagement opportunities for building national ownership of the NDC process. Activity 2.7. Provide resources for capacity building programmes targeting sectoral and sub-national government stakeholders to enable greater participation and ownership of the NDC updating process
Output 3: The capacity of Government (Ministry of Land and Environment) in charge of coordinating the NDC revision process is strengthened.
Activities: Activity 3.1.Support the government to Convey the first Civil society government meeting to share the NDC review plan and get the preliminary inputs Activity 3.2. Provide resources for capacity building programmes targeting sectoral and sub-national government stakeholders toenable greater participation and ownership of the NDC updating process. Activity 3.3. Provide technical support for specific technical areas using the pool of Oxfam technical capacity , including research Activity 3.4. Support the government to Organise final Stakeholders meeting for endorsement of the NDC to be submitted to the Council of Ministers for final approval before its submission.

participating-org.narrative: Oxfam Novib is one of the 17 national affiliates of the Oxfam International Confederation. It started life in 1956 as the Netherlands Organisation for International Assistance (Novib), and joined forces with Oxfam in 1994. Working together in confederation, the Oxfam affiliates can speak with one clear and compelling voice on issues of global concern: climate change, health and education forall, agriculture, trade, and conflicts and emergencies. Oxfam established this country office to support local organizations and projects. Through this local office Oxfam Novib directly contributes towards this project’s implementation.
